author: telthetruth
body:
Swap presents for another XP tome, buy a xp shrine from one of your guilds, pop xp potion Vulcan brew and Hallowed candle if you have them, then run as many goblin fortresses as you only defeating the bosses (T9 Orc Lord should give you more xp than most raids depending on your xp boost)

OR run towers for the nice xp granted after every floor on higher floors

OR find a T10 player within the xp share range (I think it’s 25 levels), join their party and have them run some endless dungeons. Just make sure you log into the app every so often to refresh the XP share timer. I forgot how long it is and someone can correct me, maybe 8 hours? Either way, you stop gaining xp share if you’re offline for too long
